recentItems.description:

Tammareddy Bharadwaja’s Honest Review on the New Ramayana Movie! | Ramayana Review | iDream 


First Impressions & Technical Brilliance: Filmmaker Tammareddy Bharadwaja shares his immediate review after watching the Hindi version of the big-budget Ramayana, praising its world-class technical standards, grand scale, and Hollywood-level visual effects comparable to Avatar.

Ravana’s Character Arc Takes Center Stage: Discussion on how the movie dedicates its first 35–40 minutes entirely to establishing Ravana (played by Yash), portraying him almost as a hero with noble intentions and shifting the traditional narrative perspective.

Critique of Rama and Sita's Portrayal: Analysis of Ranbir Kapoor’s depiction of Lord Rama, why it feels different from classic mythological portrayals (like those of legendary actor NTR), and thoughts on Sai Pallavi’s performance, action sequences, and styling as Sita.

Comparison with Adipurush & Classics: Drawing clear distinctions from previous misfires like Adipurush, emphasizing that this film is a prestigious, high-budget global cinematic experience despite straying from traditional mythological adaptations.

Music & Emotional Impact: Evaluating AR Rahman’s musical score and background score, exploring whether the emotional beats and classic devotional fervor match timeless cinematic masterpieces of the past.
